prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: production transparent PNG character sprite for a native educational hardware game.
Input images: Image 1 is the identity, costume, illustration-style and presenting-pose reference: use the girl on the lower right, not the interface or furniture. Image 2 is the compatible hand-drawn workshop-game art direction reference only.
Primary request: Create ONE clean character cutout of the SAME anime girl as image 1, presented large in the right foreground of a friendly physical circuit workshop. Give her a welcoming, knowledgeable, gentle smile. Her body faces slightly toward screen left and her face looks toward the player. Her arm on the screen-left side extends comfortably toward screen left, elbow naturally bent, open palm up, as if inviting the player to try a circuit. The other arm rests naturally at her side. Preserve her short black bob hair, dark softly shaded bangs, bright blue eyes, small white-iridescent cyan/lavender rectangular hair clip on the screen-right side, white and dark circular ear devices with cyan glowing rings, white high-neck shirt with narrow lavender center line, black hooded jacket with white panels and cyan piping, and black waist belt.
Style/medium: polished hand-drawn Japanese anime visual-novel game illustration, clean dark linework, soft cel shading, subtly textured clothing, coherent anatomy and hands, warm pale skin, understated cyan accents. Exactly match the reference girl's face and costume; keep her youthful adult appearance. No realistic 3D rendering.
Composition/framing: portrait canvas about 1024 x 1536. Show the COMPLETE head and hair, both ear devices, both shoulders, both arms and hands, torso, belt and upper hips. The presenting hand is clearly visible toward the left, with relaxed naturally separated fingers. Do not crop fingers, hair, elbows, or shoulders; leave a small transparent safety margin around every outer edge. Center the overall character-and-hand silhouette in the canvas. The lower crop may end below the belt at the upper thighs. Flat eye-level camera, no lens distortion.
Background: actual fully transparent alpha channel, no room, no table, no backdrop, no floor, no cast shadow, no checkerboard pattern baked into pixels. Only the character, with clean anti-aliased transparent edges.
Constraints: one character only; no props; no UI; no speech bubble; no text; no watermark; no logos; no extra limbs or fingers. Preserve character identity. PNG with real alpha transparency.
final_asset_background: RGB green chroma key, converted to RGBA by the existing ImageProcessing.removeGreenScreen at load time
final_background_edit_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Change ONLY the background of this exact supplied anime-girl cutout. Replace every gray-and-white checkerboard background pixel with a perfectly uniform solid RGB(0,255,0), hexadecimal #00FF00 bright green chroma-key background. This time use solid green, NOT transparency. Preserve the exact same girl, presenting pose, every finger, facial expression, black bob hair, headset, costume, linework, coloring, proportions, canvas size and framing. Do not redraw or restyle the girl. There must be no checkerboard left in the image, including the spaces between fingers and around the hair, hands, sleeves and body silhouette. No green tint on the girl's skin or clothing. Background is 100% flat #00FF00 with no gradient, shadow, texture, illumination or variation. One character only, no text, no borders, no new objects. Keep a few pixels of green margin around head, hands and shoulders.
